about.title: Why Civic Infrastructure Memory Matters
about.p1: Traditional municipal grievance portals discard critical institutional memory once a ticket is marked resolved. When the same pothole re-emerges weeks later or a culvert repeatedly floods during rainfall, municipal teams treat each event as an isolated incident.
about.p2: Civic Infrastructure Memory assigns a permanent internal ID to physical assets, joining citizen complaints, camera evidence, sensor readings, and contractor work orders into an enduring timeline.
about.p3: By pairing multilingual natural language understanding with computer vision (YOLO defect identification and DINOv2 visual similarity), city engineers detect recurring failures, prevent wasted patching expenditure, and prioritize high-risk infrastructure.
